lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular clusters of high-luminance pixels arranged in quasi-linear vertical columns, with inter-blob spacing increasing posteriorly from the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance blobs, creating a rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, consistent with longitudinal ridges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 6-8 visible high-luminance blobs concentrated towards the posterior and basal regions.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense concentration of smaller high-luminance blobs compared to the larger, more widely spaced patterning on the lateral flank.
